aboutParagraph1: Hi! I'm the developer behind My Album FIFA 2026 ☕⚽
aboutParagraph2: This app was born out of pure frustration 😂: I was pasting stickers and got tired of flipping back to the physical index every five minutes. So I built a search tool... and couldn't stop there.
aboutParagraph2b: Today it's a full digital album: search your country, mark the stickers you have, log your duplicates, and track your whole collection from any device.
aboutParagraph3: And to keep the kids (and the not-so-kids!) entertained, I added fun facts about each national team. All free, no ads, and always in your pocket.

aboutParagraph4d: The goal is to keep creating fun tools to make completing the World Cup album simpler, social and fun — for families, for the nostalgic ones, and for those just starting out ❤️

feature.sticker-panel-page.title: Album page in sticker panel
feature.sticker-panel-page.description: The sticker panel now shows the corresponding physical album page (e.g. 'Stickers SWE · Page 8') so you know exactly where to find each team.
feature.player-search.title: Player search
feature.player-search.description: You can now search for individual stickers by player name (e.g. MESSI) or exact code (e.g. ARG 17). Results show as standalone cards and the panel automatically highlights the matched sticker.
feature.avatar-refresh.title: New user avatar
feature.avatar-refresh.description: The user button now shows your Google profile picture when signed in, or your initial as a fallback when no photo is available. Cleaner and more minimal.
feature.design-refresh-may28.title: New navigation bar and progress states
feature.design-refresh-may28.description: The top bar is now sticky, and your collection summary has been moved to the user menu. Community stats have been added, making the search bar much more accessible.
feature.site-redesign.title: New site visual design
feature.site-redesign.description: Complete redesign with new typography, modern colors and better visual organization. Light theme is now the default, but you can switch to dark mode anytime from the footer.
feature.card-collection-stats.title: Collection count on every card
feature.card-collection-stats.descriptio: Country cards now show your progress: how many stickers you have out of the total, how many duplicates, and the group appears more discreetly next to the country code.
feature.sticker-card-feedback.title: Visual indicator for completed panels
feature.sticker-card-feedback.descriptio: When you complete all stickers for a country, the panel celebrates with a shimmer animation.
feature.theme-consistency.title: Light mode visual consistency improvements
feature.theme-consistency.description: New light/dark theme toggle with improved visual consistency. Fixed colors, borders, and visibility across all components
feature.import-collection.title: Import collection from another account
feature.import-collection.description: You can now copy the full collection from another account into yours with a single click. Available in your user menu. Your data is automatically backed up before importing, in case anything goes wrong.
feature.i18n-support.title: Full English and Spanish support
feature.i18n-support.description: The app is now available in English and Spanish. Switch languages from the footer. Country curiosities, dates, and all interface text adapt to the selected language.
feature.ux-improvements.title: Search usability improvements
feature.ux-improvements.description: The search bar now has two separate actions: the X clears text without losing focus (keyboard stays open on mobile), and the ← arrow goes back to the full list. The "I don't have it" button in the sticker modal is now red so it stands out clearly.
feature.last-touched.title: Last-touched sticker indicator
feature.last-touched.description: When you mark, unmark, or open the modal for a sticker, that card is highlighted with a yellow border so you don't lose your place between taps. The highlight disappears when you tap outside the panel.
feature.global-stats.title: Global counters — My Album
feature.global-stats.description: You can now see the complete summary of your collection at a glance: how many team, FWC, and CC stickers you have, plus your total duplicates. The panel updates in real time as you mark stickers.
feature.release-may27.title: 00 PANINI card + fixes
feature.release-may27.description: Added the special 00 PANINI card · Fixed a horizontal overflow on mobile with country cards · Updated the donation link to MercadoPago.
feature.fwc-cc-cards.title: FWC and CC cards
feature.fwc-cc-cards.description: The album's special sections have been added: FWC (19 cards, pages 1–3 and 106–109) and CC (14 cards, pages 112–113). You can search them by name and track your stickers just like with national teams.
feature.nav-redesign.title: Navigation redesign
feature.nav-redesign.description: Cleaner top-bar: just What's New and your profile. The user button now shows your name with a dropdown menu. Footer items have been reorganized.
welcomeBody2: type a country code or player name in the search box or click any country from the list.
welcomeBody3: The 20 sticker slots for that national team will appear, and you can mark the ones you already have and the duplicates with a click. Have fun!
newFeatureBody: Sign in with Google and access your personal collection from any device. Mark the stickers you already have with a click and instantly see which ones you're missing. After signing in, select a country and you can start tracking your stickers.
footerDisclaimer: This project has no affiliation with Panini, FIFA, or Coca-Cola. It is an independent project for entertainment and collecting purposes.
